Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 2 (*Akālacīvara*, "Distributing out-of-season robe-cloth") is the second rule in the chapter on offenses entailing relinquishment and confession (*nissaggiya pācittiya*) in the nun's analysis of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The disciplinary rule establishes that a nun who distributes robe-cloth inappropriately must relinquish the robe-cloth and confess the offense [SuttaCentral]. An English translation of the text is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
Curated parallels recorded on SuttaCentral demonstrate that this legal precept was transmitted broadly across early Buddhist monastic lineages [SuttaCentral]. Within the Pali tradition, it corresponds directly to Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha Nissaggiya Pācittiya 2 (*pli-tv-bi-pm-np2*) and is treated in the Bhikkhunī Parivāra [SuttaCentral]. Cross-tradition parallels include Prātimokṣa and Vibhaṅga versions in Dharmaguptaka (*Lzh Dg Bi Vb Np 27*), Sarvāstivāda (*Lzh Sarv Bi Vb Np20* and *Np21*), Mahīśāsaka (*Lzh Mi Bi Vb Np20*), and Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya recensions preserved in Chinese (*Lzh Mu Bi Vb Np 22*, *Np 23*) and Classical Tibetan (*xct-mu-bi-vb-np22*, *np23*) [SuttaCentral].
